q: What is your career goals for next years?
a:
My career goal for next years is to build a successful career in the aviation sector. I aim to become a senior cabin crew member at Qatar Airways.

I want to learn more about aviation and improve my skills in conflict management and team coordination.

I want to specialize in areas such as customer service and safety procedures.

Additionally, I hope to take on more responsibilities, such as training new staff. My goal is to be a valuable part of Qatar Airways and contribute to its success.
